concepts.def: Massive bloated star fusing heavier elements before supernova.
Shell of gas shed by a dying low-mass star.
Final fusion product in massive stars; cannot release energy.
Remnant of very massive star; gravity traps even light.
~1.4 solar masses; white dwarf maximum mass.
Fusion creating heavier elements in stellar cores.

walkthroughs.body_html: A star above ~8 solar masses fuses ever heavier elements up to iron. Iron fusion absorbs energy, so the core collapses, rebounds, and the star explodes as a supernova leaving a neutron star or black hole.
The Sun will exit the main sequence in ~5 billion years, become a red giant, shed a planetary nebula, and end as a white dwarf about Earth's size, cooling slowly for trillions of years.
State the mass range, give the path (main sequence -> giant phase -> remnant), and link to evidence (e.g., HR diagram position, supernova remnants like the Crab Nebula).
